name: Kolase Paper
tagline: bang-motion's kartun kolase: cream paper with stains, flat cut-outs, mustard / orange / red / teal pills, Caveat handwriting.

motion.direction: bang-motion kartun kolase. Cream paper with grain and stains; flat paper cut-outs (`imageCard`s with a white sticker edge), colour pills (`chips`) in mustard `gold`, orange `ter`, red and teal `goldd`; Fraunces 700–800 titles and Caveat 600–700 handwriting for annotations (≥ 48 px). Elements pop on a spring and lift out; 3–5 elements stack per scene, one per phrase; every named thing gets a picture. Text pocket ≤ 25 % or ≥ 80 % luminance; backgrounds never flat. Sentence case; caps-bold only in ONE emphasis scene.
